name: Eagle 7B announcement: Soaring past Transformers (RWKV-v5)
notes: Vendor announcement of RWKV-v5 Eagle 7B. States verbatim: "Eagle 7B is a 7.52B parameter model". Same sentence is repeated on the native weights card at https://huggingface.co/RWKV/v5-Eagle-7B-pth. Also states Apache-2.0 via the Linux Foundation, 1.1T tokens, and the inference routes: the rwkv pip package, RWKV.cpp (https://github.com/saharNooby/rwkv.cpp), and the RWKV-Runner desktop app. English evals named in the post are commonsense/world-knowledge suites (LAMBADA, StoryCloze, WinoGrande, HeadQA, SciQ), not SWE-bench, GPQA, AIME, or Terminal-Bench, so the 7.52B figure is used for the parameter count only. kind is blog because it is a vendor post; the parameter sentence is a vendor claim, not a tensor measurement.
